steps.content: In some corner on the banks of the Rust, a black umbrella fishes a black raincoat out of a heap of trash. The lining of the raincoat is covered with stinky skin and flesh.
The owner shakes off the filth on the umbrella, and opens it again.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: So merciless... That spider lady, she really lives up to the name...

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: If I had used her then, I would've had a magnificent Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Anyway, the outcome wasn't a shock. After all, it was a feral Corpus that had been suppressed for many years. It was only normal that it lost.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Yes, it was that defective again.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: It did surprise me that he was the one who destroyed BR-004. But he had earned his right. It was not a battle I could get involved in.
steps.female_content: It did surprise me that she was the one who destroyed BR-004. But she had earned her right. It was not a battle I could get involved in.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: But it's all over now. Now what? Should I do something about him? Kill him, maybe?
steps.female_content: But it's all over now. Now what? Should I do something about her? Kill her, maybe?

steps.content: Bang!
A bullet perforates the black umbrella, enters the man's skull, and penetrates his brainstem.
He falls onto the ground, his mouth open. It doesn't take long for the black flames to burn the body into nothingness.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Is he dead?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: It takes more than two shots to kill a monster like him.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: What? Why look so serious? Is the situation that bad?

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Nothing. I was just thinking... that shooting a man from a helicopter might seem a bit over-the-top.
Langley snickers, puts down the handgun, and takes the walkie-talkie from the clerk's hand.

steps.speaker: MBCC Chief
steps.content: What kind of celebratory party leaves out the person being congratulated?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Sorry... Special agents have a tight schedule. We have to deal with traitors and get rid of the evil forces. Those rats in the gutter have reared their ugly heads again...

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Oh, by the way, you and your MBCC are now officially under the leadership of the 9th Agency, which means, from now on, I'm your boss.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Enjoy the last bit of your leisure time. Your work ahead won't be easy.
Ignoring the complaints on the other end of the line, Langley hangs up.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Better get back to the Paradeisos. The geezers are waiting for my report.
A few key words have been marked red on the documents inside the blood-stained document envelope in her hand.
...<color=#fb9259>Syndicate, Deus Corpus, activating. WhiteSands, abnormal activity confirmed.</color>
